name: EXOSFEAR
author: hjonesjr
description:
LEGO Ideas username: 

HJonesJr EXOSFEAR is an epic game that takes place around the Orbitron-C space station, abandoned in the Earth’s exosphere. The game is based on an original suspense story previously introduced in the Lego Microgame Thermosfear and its story begins immediately after the ending of Thermosfear. In this game, you once again play as Astronaut “Brick” Jones who has been left stranded and unconscious after being attacked by CHMP32. Will you be able to survive and get back to Earth? Good luck. And don’t have FEAR…
